title: Binance Wallet Prediction Markets Integrates Predict Points (PP)
text: This is a general announcement. The products and services referred to herein may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Wallet Prediction Markets has officially integrated the Predict Points system (hereinafter referred to as “PP” or “Points”), which is provided and operated by Predict.fun. Users can earn PP by participating in market trading, providing liquidity, holding positions, and engaging in other eligible market activities on Binance Wallet Prediction Markets. What Is Predict Points (PP): PP is a native points-based incentive system launched by Predict.fun to measure users’ activity, contribution, and long-term engagement in its prediction markets. Users may earn PP by trading, providing liquidity, holding positions, and engaging in more market activities. For the specific PP rules, calculation methods, statistical periods, and subsequent adjustments, please refer to the latest content available on  Predict.fun’s official page .  Binance Wallet serves solely as a display platform for PP-related information. In the event of data delays, disputes regarding points calculation, leaderboard results, or related issues, the information displayed on Predict.fun’s official system shall prevail. How to Earn Predict Points (PP): Users may earn PP by participating in Prediction Markets: Binance Exchange (App): Go to [Markets] > [Prediction] Binance Wallet (App): Go to [Home] > [Prediction] Eligible trading, order placement, and position-holding activities will be automatically included in each week’s calculations. For more questions regarding PP, please refer to this  FAQ . Historical PP Allocation: This launch supports historical PP backfill. It is expected to be completed and synchronized  by 2026-06-02 13:00 (UTC+8) . Eligible historical trading records will be automatically included, and users may view their personal points in the Binance App by visiting [Assets] > [Prediction Account] or go to Binance Wallet > [Prediction Markets] > [Assets]. For More Details: Frequently Asked Questions on Predict Points (PP) on Binance Wallet Predict.fun’s official page Note: There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.  Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-06-02 Risk Warning:  Binance reserves the right to amend or cancel this announcement at any time and for any reason without prior notice. Disclaimer:  Prediction Markets are not provided by Binance’s ADGM entity and are accessible only if you hold a Binance Wallet. Binance Wallet services are provided by Binance Barbados Limited. Binance Wallet services are not regulated by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority or any other regulatory authority. Binance Wallet does not sponsor, endorse, or guarantee such third-party services. Binance is not a counterparty to any investment made in the Prediction Markets feature. Investments made using the Prediction Markets feature involve significant risks, including financial risk, market volatility, regulatory risk, and third-party risk. You may lose part or all of the amount invested through the Prediction Markets feature. For more information, please refer to our Risk Warning and Terms of Use. Prediction Markets and the PP system may not be available to certain countries, regions, or users. Users are responsible for ensuring that their use of the relevant services complies with applicable local laws, regulations, and platform requirements.
